title: Section formula implies the normalized geometric-stalk square
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, e:V -> T etale, M and N constant-A module sheaves on V_et and T_et, respectively, and let p:e_!M tensor N -> e_!(M tensor e^*N) be any sheaf morphism. Assume p sends each tensor of a summand section m and a target section n to the summand section of m tensor etaleLiftSection(n). Then for every geometric point t:Spec Omega -> T, stalk(p) followed by the target comparison equals the source comparison followed by TensorProduct.directSumLeft. The comparisons are exactly those fixed in [def-pur-etale-projection-data]. No invertibility or naturality of p is assumed.

proof.text: Cancel the source stalk comparison and TensorProduct.directSumLeft. Direct-sum linear-map extensionality reduces to one lift summand. Precompose with the tensor of the identity and the canonical inverse-image stalk isomorphism. The invertible oplax tensorator of the filtered presheaf-fibre functor and its colimit universal property reduce to pure tensors of two section germs on the same source neighbourhood. For etale e, upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction expresses each inverse-image section as etaleLiftSection of a target section on the composed neighbourhood. The sum-stalk and tensor-stalk unit equations then identify the source tensor with the germ of the corresponding tensor section.

Naturality of germs and the assumed section formula yield the germ of the sum section of m tensor etaleLiftSection(n). The sum-stalk germ equation followed by the tensor-stalk unit equation computes its target image. Prove directly from the canonical sheaf pullback comparison that the inverse-image unit has the original target germ, with module coefficients; graph restriction preserves that germ by the pointed restriction equation and the map/pullback adjunction triangle. Transport along the lift triangle to obtain exactly the fixed etaleProjectionLiftStalkIso. Therefore the image is the same lift summand containing the tensor of the two original germs.

The lower map TensorProduct.directSumLeft has exactly this formula on generators. Additivity, tensor induction, finite support and the stalk colimit universal property prove the equality, including the empty lift fibre.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GKF stalk square, proved using the declared sum/tensor germ formulas and a direct module-valued proof of the canonical unit-germ equation. The etale localization comparison avoids a separate common-refinement construction.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleProjection_stalk_normalization (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {V T : Scheme.{u}} (e : V ⟶ T) [Etale e]
    (M : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (N : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (p : etaleSheafTensor A T
        ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e inferInstance).obj M) N ⟶
      (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e inferInstance).obj
        (etaleSheafTensor A V M ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).obj N)))
    (hp : ∀ (W : V.Etale) (m : M.obj.obj (op W))
      (n : N.obj.obj
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj W))),
      p.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj W))
          (etaleSheafTensorSection A _ N
            ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj W)
            (etaleSumSection A e M W m) n) =
        etaleSumSection A e _ W
          (etaleSheafTensorSection A M _ W m (etaleLiftSection A e N W n)))
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ T) :
    ((Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).map p ≫
        (etaleProjectionTargetStalkIso A e t M N).hom =
      (etaleProjectionSourceStalkIso A e t M N).hom ≫
        (etaleProjectionDirectSumTensorIso A e t M N).hom
